name: proxy
displayName: Proxy Smart — SMART on FHIR administration
description: Administer a SMART on FHIR authorization proxy from the conversation. Bundles the smart-app-onboarding and smart-launch-debugging skills + the Proxy Smart MCP server, whose tools are generated from the admin API: register and configure SMART apps, manage scopes and scope sets, healthcare users and practitioner roles, FHIR servers, identity providers, and Keycloak Organizations. Connects to the hosted production deployment (api.proxy-smart.com) by default; set PROXY_SMART_URL to administer your own instance instead.
